name: nanopost-email-check
description: Development tools for nanoPost Email Check.

scripts.plugin-check: wp-env run cli wp plugin check nanopost-email-check --exclude-directories=dist,vendor,node_modules,.github,tests,.wordpress-org,screenshots --exclude-files=.wp-env.json,.wp-env.override.json,.gitattributes,.gitignore,phpcs.xml.dist,composer.json,composer.lock,package.json,package-lock.json,CLAUDE.md
scripts.zip: mkdir -p dist && git archive --format=zip --prefix=nanopost-email-check/ -o dist/nanopost-email-check.zip HEAD
